== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ストーカー</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">6名のパイロット、8名の乗客、2台のビークル、4機のタイを搭乗させられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。同じ星系の位置にプローブ・ドロイドをフォースを消費せずに配備できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">元はアウター・リムで新たな惑星を征服する任務に就いていた。エコー基地を発見したプローブ・ドロイドを送りだした。後にデス・スコードロンに転属となった。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Stalker.

'''Lore''' — It was originally assigned to conquer new planets in the Outer Rim. It launched the probe droid that found Echo Base. It was later reassigned to Death Squadron.

'''Game text''' — May carry 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. Probe droids may deploy free to locations of the same system.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore says it was on a mission to conquer new Outer Rim planets and omits searching. The face prints Pilot and Scomp Link and omits Nav Computer. Probe droids deploy free to same-system locations, not related sites. TIEs are タイ.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-stalker.gif|Original English face]], [[Stalker]].</ref>
